name: Acmer S2 Pro 48W
tagline: Top Acmer S2 Pro — 48W compressed diode with bundle options
tldr: Acmer S2 Pro 48W is Acmer's high-power open-frame option before the enclosed P3. Strong cutting claims — verify optical power and compare to P3 48W enclosed if you need smoke control.
mainObjective: Fast hobby engraving and cutting — thicker basswood, dark acrylic, and shorter job times

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Competitive vs P3 if you have ventilation
beginnerNotes: Choose P3 instead if you need integrated enclosure and camera.
proTips: All-in-one packs often include extras you won't use — price the Basic pack.
primaryUse: High-power Acmer open-frame for cutting-heavy hobby or side business.
